item.title: Utah couple shares secrets to 65-year marriage ahead of Valentine’s Day
item.description: As Valentine’s Day approaches, a Utah couple celebrating 65 years of marriage is sharing the simple values they believe helped their love stand the test of time.Gordan and Joann Westover, who married in 1961, recently took part in a newlywed-style game at their retirement community to see how well they still know each other after decades together. While not every answer matched perfectly, their connection was clear.Joann says one key to their lasting relationship is avoiding unresolved conflict.

item.title: Firebirds win first game out of the All-Star break 6-1 over Roadrunners
item.description: The Coachella Valley Firebirds unloaded for six goals Friday night on Kraken Night against the Tucson Roadrunners. Andrei Loshko had a goal and two assists for a three-point night. Our Tim O'Brien has the recap from Acrisure Arena. For more Coachella Valley News visit NBCPalmSprings.com
